claim: Dockview is a zero-dependency docking layout manager for IDE-like interfaces with tabs, groups, grids, splitviews, drag-and-drop, floating panels and popout windows.
quote: A zero dependency docking layout manager for building IDE-like interfaces with tabs, groups, grids, splitviews, drag and drop, floating panels, and popout windows.

claim: Dockview repo is MIT-licensed, actively maintained (pushed July 2026), zero runtime dependencies, supports React/Vue/Angular/vanilla TS.
quote: Zero dependency docking layout manager supporting tabs, groups, grids and splitviews. Supports React, Vue, Angular, and vanilla TypeScript.

claim: react-mosaic v7 moves from binary to n-ary tree, makes tabs a first-class node type, and targets React 16-19 with ESM+CJS.
quote: v7 is a major release. The layout engine moves from a binary tree to an n-ary tree, tabs become a first-class node type, and the library now targets React 16-19 with a full ESM + CJS build.

claim: FlexLayout uses a JSON model (Model.fromJson/toJson), supports popout windows via enablePopout, multiple built-in themes, and its only dependency is React.
quote: Tabs can be rendered into external browser windows (useful for multi-monitor setups) by using the enablePopout and enablePopoutIcon attributes.

claim: rc-dock supports popup panels as new browser windows, saveLayout/loadLayout serialization, and a dark theme.
quote: saveLayout(): SavedLayout - save layout; loadLayout(savedLayout: SavedLayout): void - load layout; Popup panel as new browser window.

claim: golden-layout v2 dropped React support and recommends React developers use FlexLayout instead.
quote: The FlexLayout library has been designed for React components. We recommend developers using React to use this library instead of Golden Layout.

claim: react-mosaic is a React tiling window manager (drag-to-resize, drag-to-rearrange), the most-starred of the four.
quote: A React tiling window manager

claim: Dockview core has no runtime dependencies; layouts save/restore via api.toJSON()/api.fromJSON(); groups can detach into floating overlays or separate browser windows.
quote: Save and restore layouts with api.toJSON() / api.fromJSON(). The core library has no runtime dependencies.

claim: Dockview v7 split React bindings into dockview-react (dockview becomes framework-agnostic JS), added keyboard navigation, layout-transaction events, and nested grids inside floating/popout windows.
quote: React bindings moved from dockview to dockview-react; dockview is now the framework-agnostic JavaScript package. Floating groups and popout windows now host their own nested grid.

claim: Dockview fires onDidAddPopoutGroup/onDidRemovePopoutGroup as popout windows open/close and getPopouts() enumerates open windows.
quote: onDidAddPopoutGroup and onDidRemovePopoutGroup fire as popout windows open and close (or dock back), and getPopouts() enumerates the open popout windows.

claim: Dockview ships built-in theme classes (dockview-theme-dark, -light, -abyss, -dracula, -replit, -vs) applied to a parent container; custom themes via CSS variables.
quote: dockview-theme-dark, dockview-theme-light, dockview-theme-abyss, dockview-theme-dracula, dockview-theme-replit, dockview-theme-vs ... custom themes can be created using CSS custom properties (CSS variables).

claim: dockview-react peer-depends on React 16.8/17/18/19, is MIT-licensed, and its only dependency is the dockview core.
Open Dockview issue: SplitviewReact is rendered twice into the DOM under React StrictMode; fine in non-strict mode.
quote: SplitviewReact rendered twice in React Strict mode

claim: Hacker News praised Dockview's TypeScript quality, zero deps and docs; noted Safari/touch demo issues and that golden-layout v2 dropping React 'is not that great'.
quote: Stellar work. The TS looks really proper on first glance. ... [golden-layout] v2 which apparently drops react support and has no documentation...it's not that great.

claim: rc-dock is Apache-2.0, ~812 stars, a React-only dock layout component.
quote: Dock Layout for React Component

claim: rc-dock's latest published version is 4.0.0-alpha.2, peer-depends on React >=17, and pulls in lodash, classnames, rc-new-window and @rc-component packages.
quote: react: >=17.0.0 ... dependencies: lodash, classnames, rc-new-window, @rc-component/menu, @rc-component/tabs, @rc-component/dropdown

claim: FlexLayout by Caplin is MIT, ~1322 stars, actively maintained (pushed July 2026), a Docking Layout Manager for React.
quote: Docking Layout Manager for React

claim: flexlayout-react v0.10.0 peer-depends on React 18/19 and has zero runtime dependencies besides React.
quote: react: ^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0 ... dependencies: []

claim: Users reported FlexLayout failing to install/run under React 19 / Next.js 15 (Dec 2024); newer 0.9+/0.10 releases add React 19 to peer deps.
quote: FlexLayout-React not supporting React 19 (Nextjs 15)

claim: react-mosaic supports React 16-19, is Apache-2.0, works with or without Blueprint (ships default CSS + CSS variables), built on react-dnd.
quote: Works with or without Blueprint; ships a default CSS theme plus CSS variables you can override.

claim: react-mosaic-component v7.0.0 is Apache-2.0 and pulls in ~11 dependencies including the react-dnd stack (react-dnd, dnd-core, html5/touch backends), lodash-es and uuid.
quote: dependencies: classnames, dnd-core, immutability-helper, lodash-es, prop-types, rdndmb-html5-to-touch, react-dnd, react-dnd-html5-backend, react-dnd-multi-backend, react-dnd-touch-backend, uuid

claim: golden-layout has ~6694 stars but its last release was v2.6.0 in September 2022.
quote: tag_name: v2.6.0, published_at: 2022-09-26

claim: A 2026 alternatives roundup calls Dockview the closest modern successor to Golden Layout with zero framework lock-in; positions rc-dock as lightweight React-only tab docking and FlexLayout as JSON-driven nested tabs for trading/admin cockpits.
quote: For an exact, modern alternative to Golden Layout with zero framework lock-in, use Dockview.

claim: npm-trends compares weekly downloads and stars across dockview, flexlayout-react, golden-layout and rc-dock.
quote: dockview vs flexlayout-react vs golden-layout vs rc-dock

claim: react-mosaic v7 beta notes document the binary-to-n-ary migration, React 19 type fixes, convertLegacyToNary() and expanded React 16-19 peer dep.
quote: React Mosaic v7.0.0-beta0 Release Notes

claim: react-mosaic layouts are a plain JSON tree that can be stringified to localStorage and restored; suits IDEs, dashboards and design tools.
quote: any changes to the layout are saved back to local storage ... to preserve user preferences across sessions.

claim: react-resizable-panels is described as the 2026 standard React library for resizable split layouts (VS Code-style), distinct from full docking managers.
quote: It is the 2026 standard React library for resizable layouts.

claim: react-resizable-panels (~5.3k stars, ~33.7M weekly downloads) does resizable splits only - no tabs, floating or docking.
quote: react-resizable-panels

claim: Allotment (~1.25k stars) reproduces the VS Code split-view visual but is a splitter, not a docking/tab manager.
quote: allotment

claim: Simpler split/resize needs are served by react-resizable-panels, react-split-pane or react-dock rather than a full docking engine.
quote: react-dock vs react-resize-panel vs react-split-pane

claim: Dockview shipped ~biweekly releases through 2025 (4.3-4.11), including popout blocked-popup handling and JS/React theming consistency fixes.
quote: Dockview 4.4.0 - Add onDidOpenPopoutWindowFail event to handle blocked popups; Dockview 4.6.2 - theming consistency between JavaScript and React implementations.

claim: The framework-agnostic dockview core package sees ~139k weekly downloads (dockview-react ~55k).
quote: dockview - Zero dependency Docking Layout Manager

claim: react-dockable is a niche (~26-star) React-only dockable-tabs alternative with a fully dynamic user-customizable layout.
quote: React library to create beautiful dockable tabbed interfaces for tools, dashboards, and more.

claim: aperturerobotics/flex-layout is a feature-fork of Caplin FlexLayout adding bug fixes, performance improvements and OptimizedLayout.
quote: a feature-fork of FlexLayout by Caplin that includes bug fixes, performance improvements and new features like OptimizedLayout.

claim: Dockview is TypeScript-first with full type definitions and a theming system built on CSS custom properties.
quote: Theming system with CSS custom properties ... TypeScript-first with full type definitions.

claim: FlexLayout's React 18 upgrade was tracked as a community-requested issue, reflecting historically slower major-React adoption than Dockview.
quote: Upgrade to React 18?
